propositions: The ticket targeted code duplication between sync.reconverge and s3_doctor._fold_heads for merge and unrelated-history logic, but Gerrit 1665 removed the doctor's worktree merge implementation, eliminating the duplication.

Sync and the S3 doctor hold contradictory policies on unrelated histories: sync refuses to merge when the local store carries events to avoid grafting orphan stores, while the doctor unions unconditionally.
Sync cannot adopt the doctor's ref-only merge-tree engine because its consumers read ticket events from worktree files and would see pre-merge state if the ref advanced without a checked-out merge.
The two healers have opposed failure policies: sync must never raise and logs warnings on merge abort, while the doctor must raise S3DoctorConflict to allow the push path to escalate and abandon.
